newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX to trade Gemstar options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX to trade Gemstar options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange said Wednesday they would list options on Gemstar International Group Ltd on May 20.
The exchanges said the options would open with strike prices of 15, 17-1/2 and 20. Introductory expirations have been set for June, July, August and November.
The AMEX said position limits of 4,500 have been set and LETCO-Specialist LP has been named specialist.
At the CBOE, Tradenet LP has been named the designated primary market maker in the options.
